about: The docs benchmark: ten things a developer comes to do. A reader with no context gets one task and only the built site's pages, and answers with the exact code and steps. `must` lists what a right answer has to contain (regular expressions, case-insensitive; every one must match). Scored by scripts/docs_bench.py; no judge model.

tasks.task: I have a React form built with react-hook-form, with two tabs. Add the Dushes chat next to it so it can fill the fields, and make the chat able to show a field that sits in the other tab. Give me the code.

My site has a Loans page and an /apply page with a loan form. When a visitor tells the site assistant on the Loans page that they want a mortgage, the form should open and the assistant should already know what they said. What do I set up on the server and in the page?
Make the chat use my brand colour #7c3aed with square corners. Give me the code.
The assistant should be able to send a booking to my API, but only after the user taps a Confirm button. Show me the server setup and the tool.
I want users to fill a short form entirely in the chat: there is no form on the page. The assistant must not tell them to look at fields on the page, and the result must go to my server. How?
The assistant should answer questions from our PDF policies and price lists, and a form should also see a shared set of documents. How do I add the documents and set this up?
Our users are German. The cards in the chat should show our own German labels and option names, without paying a model to translate them. What do I write?
We are on Azure OpenAI. Use gpt-5 for the conversation and the cheaper gpt-5-mini for research. Give me the configuration.
I am putting the assistant on the internet for my site https://my.app. What must I set so only my site can call it and conversations survive a restart?
Every morning I want to read yesterday's conversations in a script, and delete conversations older than 30 days. Give me the Python.
